headline: Small SSE windswell with clean offshore wind — a proper log-it day.
today: Nothing big, 2 to 2.5ft at a short 6s from the SSE, but the wind is on our side all day — cross-off in the morning swinging fully offshore by afternoon and evening. It stays clean throughout, so surf whenever it suits you and lean on the outgoing tide toward that 2:49p low. Bring the log or the groveler and make the most of the glass.

daysToWatch.note: Best of the small stuff: 6.5-6.9s SE at a good angle with light WNW at dawn. Get the dawn patrol in before the S onshore fills in by afternoon.
Onshore ramps to 21mph in the afternoon on top of a weak short-period swell. Blown out and junky — skip it.
Wind goes cross-off in the afternoon and glasses off light in the evening. Worth a late check if any of that short-period SSE fills in.
